scope: Raw local model with gold context; no RAG, backend, schema repair, generated code execution or application guards.
acceptance: Each case: all prewritten semantic criteria; exact JSON/schema separate; critical factual errors, answer leakage and unsupported mastery are failures. Full pass requires both semantic and technical validity. No readiness claim from this small synthetic sample.
holdout_policy: Freeze prompt before any holdout call. No tuning after holdout; future tuning retires it. Test families differ but curriculum concepts overlap: limited within-domain holdout, not generalisation proof.
latency: Warmup excluded; every planned task incl timeout/error in denominator. Report full-response p50/p95 and server TTFT separately, no streaming UX claim. Timeout120s. Single concurrency; load test1–2 deferred until quality gate.
